{{Quote|H&hellip;help me! Please! I can&hellip;I can feel it inside my skin! Something growing&hellip;like some kind of hideous disease!|The Republic soldier, to Revan|<ref name="kotor" />}}
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Republic soldier''' was a crew member of the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]''. When the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attacked]] and boarded by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he fled the ''Endar Spire'' along with several others in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], crashing in the planet's [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]]. Following the crash, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier's]] companions were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[rakghoul]] creatures, while he was wounded and contracted the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. Several days later, the man was found and [[Rakghoul serum|cured]] by fellow [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Army|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] but was killed by rakghouls immediately thereafter.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Those things&mdash;they attacked as soon as we came out the doors. They&hellip;they killed the others. It was&hellip;it was horrible.|The Republic soldier|<ref name="kotor" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] served the [[Republic Army|Galactic Republic Army]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] against the forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="kotor" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Guide" /> the soldier served aboard the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' under the command of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]].<ref name="kotor" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''Endar Spire'' was dispatched along with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Fleet/Legends|battle fleet]] to engage Malak's invasion fleet at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="COTOR11">''[[Chronicles of the Old Republic]] Part XI: Knights of the Old Republic''</ref> A [[Attack on the Endar Spire|battle]] erupted in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Taris, and the ''Endar Spire'' was boarded by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who attempted to capture Shan. However, she was able to flee the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], and with their prey gone, the Sith were willing to destroy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] vessel. The soldier and several other crewmen managed to reach an escape pod and jettison shortly before the ''Endar Spire''{{'s}} destruction.<ref name="kotor" />

[[File:Crashed_escape_pod.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The escape pod used by the soldier to escape from the ''Endar Spire'', crashed in the Undercity]]
As the survivors' escape pod plummeted toward Taris, the soldiers picked up a signal from Shan's own pod. Just before they reached the planet's [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]], the escapees tracked Shan's pod, seeing as it went down somewhere to the west. Soon, their own pod also crashed in the Undercity, and they lost the signal from Shan's craft. When the surviving soldiers emerged from their escape pod, they were attacked by vicious [[rakghoul]] creatures that [[Death/Legends|killed]] everyone except for the soldier. The man was wounded and contracted the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], however, which would eventually turn him into a rakghoul as well. Feeling immense pain and terrified by the rakghouls roaming nearby, the soldier survived for several days near the downed escape pod.<ref name="kotor" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
Eventually, the man was found by fellow Republic soldiers [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Carth Onasi]], two other survivors from the ''Endar Spire'', who were [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|searching for Shan]]. Still experiencing the effects of the plague, the man asked the two for help, and Revan gave him [[rakghoul serum]], which he had just found while searching the remains of a [[Unidentified Sith trooper (Rakghoul serum)|Sith trooper]] nearby. The man injected himself with the serum and was immediately cured of the disease. Revan questioned him about Shan, and the man revealed to him what he knew about her pod's crash site. However, the soldier then believed that he heard the rakghouls moving closer&mdash;even though Revan heard nothing&mdash;and the man felt that the creatures were coming back to finish him. Frightened, the soldier bolted away but ran into a group of rakghouls and was killed by them.<ref name="kotor" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Over there&hellip;I heard something. I know I did! There it is again! It's those monsters! They're coming back! Run for your lives!|The Republic soldier, to Revan and his companions|<ref name="kotor" />}}
The Republic soldier was deeply affected by the sight of his comrades getting slaughtered by rakghouls. He was very frightened of the creatures, which ultimately led to his demise when he tried to escape from them in a panic. The man had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin.<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|No&hellip;no, no!!! I can feel&hellip;ARGH!|The Republic soldier, transforming into a rakghoul|<ref name="kotor" />}}
This Republic soldier appeared as a non-playable character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. The player, controlling Revan, can meet him in the Undercity, though the nature of the encounter is such that it does not progress the game's storyline and is not necessary to complete the game. However, giving the rakghoul serum to the soldier rewards the player with [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points. Upon meeting the infected soldier, the player may also tell him to stay away or refuse to give the serum to him until he reveals some useful information. In both cases, the soldier will transform into a rakghoul and will attack Revan. The same also happens if the player has not obtained the serum yet but promises to find something to help. If the player approaches the soldier after Bastila Shan has already been rescued and gives him the serum, the option to ask him about Shan's pod will not be available, and the soldier will run away to his death immediately after injecting himself with the serum.<ref name="kotor" />
